summary: The implementation successfully addresses all three requirements. Front nine and back nine subtotals have been added to the score entry cards with proper labels and automatic calculation. A PDF generation feature has been added to the leaderboard view with a 'Generate PDF' button. The implementation is complete and matches the BuildRequest specifications.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an 'Export PDF' button in addition to the 'Generate PDF' button for PDF export functionality
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specified a single PDF generation feature for the leaderboard view (REQ-3), but the implementation includes two separate PDF export buttons: 'Generate PDF' (handleExportLeaderboardPdf) and 'Export PDF' (handleExportStandingsPdf)
